item.title: Sense of Self
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: What turns an information processing living thing into something which experiences? What is this entity having these experiences? Why is there always someone having the experiences? Well, let us understand The Architecture of the Experiencing Self What is it that makes you you? Our sense of owning our hand, initiating our actions, the invisible bubble of space close to the body that feels like ours, the sense that our self is located somewhere within our body even when we are in a sensory deprived chamber - these are not philosophical abstractions.

item.title: Cool Papers
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: God wanted to hide his secrets in a secure place. ‘Would I put them on the moon?’ He reflected. ‘But then, one day human beings could get there, and it could be that those who would arrive there would not be worthy of the secret knowledge. Or perhaps I should hide them in the depths of the ocean,’ God entertained another possibility. But, again, for the same reasons, he dismissed it.

item.title: Book Reviews
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: The Antipodes of the Mind - Charting the Phenomenology of the Ayahuasca Experience Early chapters exploring the psychological, chemical, and cultural foundations of the Ayahuasca experience. In these opening chapters, the author approaches Ayahuasca not just as an exotic cultural artifact, but as a serious subject for cognitive psychology. The Personal Encounter & Psychological Riddles The author initially felt that seeing specific animals like snakes and jaguars seemed too specific to define cognitive universals.

item.title: Mentees
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: Below are the brave souls (past and present) who have undergone the Wax On, Wax Off journey with me. Each of them has not only mastered the science but also survived my Jack of all, Master of None approach to supervision - a path that involves a heavy dose of rigorous discussion and the occasional hour-long tangential journey through science, life, and stories. You should reach out and talk to my mentees to get a first person perspective of my mentoring style, plus and minus.

item.title: Mentor Mentee
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: Thank you for reaching out to me. As a freshly minted scientist and a long term resident at the Centre for Consciousness Studies, NIMHANS my five year goal (2026-2030) is to establish a new research niche focused on the Sense of Self. Simultaneously, I aim to mentor and up skill the members and contribute meaningfully to all the great projects happening at our centre. I picked this work place because of the work ethic and culture passed down by my mentors: a lab environment that is scientifically rigorous yet positive, free, engaging, challenging, and rewarding.

item.title: Whirlwind tour of my research work
item.author: rhlvenugopal@gmail.com (xxxx)
item.description: From Circuits to Consciousness Welcome to my journey so far from the world of electronics and communication engineering to Consciousness research. I began my career designing logic on circuit boards, only to realise the most complex operating system runs on wetware where there is no clear demarcation of the data, hardware and software. I traded silicon for synapses, and today, as a Cognitive Scientist at the Centre for Consciousness Studies (NIMHANS), my work revolves around multiple states (non ordinary as well) of Consciousness across illness and wellness in waking, sleeping, tasking, meditating and dreaming humans.
